item.text:
The report now documents eighteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F18: `Follower.processPacket` calls `fzk.pendingTxns.element()` for `COMMITANDACTIVATE` without checking for a pending proposal**. An out-of-order or malformed commit/activate packet therefore escapes as an unchecked `NoSuchElementException`:

```
java.util.NoSuchElementException
  at java.base/java.util.AbstractQueue.element(AbstractQueue.java:136)
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.Follower.processPacket(Follower.java:211)
AssertionError: empty COMMITANDACTIVATE escaped as an unchecked queue exception
```

Reproduction: [CommitActivateEmptyRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/commit_activate_empty/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/CommitActivateEmptyRepro.java).

I also ran a focused recovery/election test set; all selected tests passed, and the raw log is retained at `executions/4637440e5b1a48d8aef60391fd85f0c1/stdout.txt`.

The seventeen earlier findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leakage, malformed transaction handling, truncation/recovery issues, oracle election/revalidation defects, follower duplicate/gap handling, empty-tail zxid overstatement, epoch initialization failure, and duplicate-zxid storage. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
